population_evidence.description: The Academic Library survey became part of the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data system in collection year 2014-15. Data include characteristics of the library, collections, expenditures and services. The number of full-time equivalent staff employed by the library were added in fiscal year 2020. Library data are only applicable for degree-granting institutions. Degree-granting institutions with total expenditures over $100,000 dollars will have expenditure data. In 2016-17 the types of collections was expanded to collect information on physical and electronic serials.
